title: Serialize shipment reference registration revision and void against live sources
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized logistics operator registering a reference must validate exact allowlisted source type/id and live eligible source under the same source lock and transaction as effective-reference uniqueness. Reject cancelled/deleted/missing source for new registration, preserve readable historical references. Two concurrent registrations for one source can create only one recorded reference; after explicit void a fresh record is permitted and previous evidence remains unchanged. No fuzzy matching or upstream/finance/inventory writes.

Serialize revision and void against the same reference row/transaction. Each successful revision preserves the immediately preceding values and monotonic revision sequence; revision racing void cannot rewrite voided evidence, duplicate void fails clearly, later validation failure rolls back both evidence and revision history. Apply existing actual source-module menu/current enabled user/customer scope to reads/candidates/history and writes, no invented permission grants or privilege expansion. Use actual controllers/services for real two-connection create/create, update/void and repeated revision tests with full original evidence retained.

implementation_evidence: ContainerShipmentReferenceService.CreateAsync reads duplicate effective reference then inserts without a source/registry transaction. UpdateAsync revision and VoidAsync read current status without mutual locking; LoadSourceAsync checks existence/deletion but permits cancelled sources.
